inputs.prompt: The reference picture is a top-view layout diagram, not a drawing of the product: the four small circles mark the motor positions and the lines show the arm directions from the body centre. Design one compact camera drone for everyday personal aerial photography that fits this layout exactly, and render it as a realistic studio product image in strict orthographic top view, front up, on white. Put one two-blade propeller on each motor. Shape the body, the camera at the front and the arm roots freely. Matte neutral gray shell, soft lighting. Do not reproduce the circles or lines of the diagram.
inputs.negative_prompt: flat schematic, line drawing, collage, text, labels, logo, cropped rotor, disconnected arm, extra rotor, perspective camera
